interpretation.fw_search: Each FW owner has incumbent plus three fully feasible neighbors per decision. FW_W observed improvement is zero; FW_E has a positive but smaller improvement than the adopted urban signal owner. No selected-cap FW search neighbor is recorded infeasible or rejected.
interpretation.selection: One partial round-robin sweep adopts the largest completely checked own-payoff improvement at the fixed incumbent, so a smaller FW_E improvement is not combined into that same update.
interpretation.coverage: Every FW finite domain announces 63 candidates. Three checked search neighbors do not exhaust it. Final audit remains incomplete for every owner; only FW_W receives final checks. All eight meter dimensions are present in independent price bases (4 per FW; 3 VSL plus 4 meter columns gives rank 7). This does not establish follower exploration of all eight meter alternatives.
interpretation.not_recorded: The selected search summary does not retain each rejected/feasible trial action, its individual objective, or its accepted-flow response. Therefore do not attribute per-meter or per-VSL evaluation counts beyond recorded owner totals, and do not claim which exact pure/coupled trial was better.
interpretation.plateau: All eight entry accepted-merge averages are below their g8 table service capacities. This is consistent with excess meter service capacity but does not establish a demand plateau: accepted flow is not unconstrained demand, and time-averaged flow does not prove every instant is unconstrained. Zero external price differences also do not prove equal full physical responses. No g8 action was executed.
interpretation.rate_units: CSV rate_vph uses the writer mapping (g10=900, hypothetical g8=720 veh/h). The physical prediction uses the empirical per-lane service table: g10=1512 and g8=1166.4 veh/h for one lane; 3024 and 2332.8 for two lanes. Do not compare CSV 900 directly with accepted merge as a physical capacity.
interpretation.negative_np: The attempted NP=-250 seed restorations stop at finite work budgets and remain unknown. They are not an infeasibility certificate for all meter/VSL alternatives.
interpretation.terminal: This note covers exposed actions 2400,2550,2700 only; terminal 2850 has no post-action exposure.
